Welcome to The Finology Podcast!
We bring you unfiltered, high-value conversations with leading market experts, top fund managers, and visionary CEOs to help you make smarter financial decisions.
In this episode, we are joined by Saurabh Mukherjea (Founder & CIO, Marcellus Investment Managers) for a masterclass on quality investing, wealth creation, and navigating market noise.
From building a portfolio strategy to analyzing corporate debt and India's credit boom, Saurabh breaks down actionable frameworks for every investor.
